import argparse
import csv
import json

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Export a JSON array of report records to CSV.")
p.add_argument("input", help="JSON file containing a list of flat objects")
p.add_argument("output", help="CSV file to write")
a = p.parse_args()

with open(a.input, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = json.load(f)

with open(a.output, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=rows[0].keys() if rows else [])
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rows)
